To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

- Emails, email attachments, calendar entries, and meeting invitations sent or received between July 1, 2017, and March 31, 2019, by U.S. Border Patrol personnel, including the account of Program Manager Kirby D. Klein, that include the word or phrase "SOFNEX" or "SOF NEX."
- Emails, email attachments, calendar entries, and meeting invitations sent or received between July 1, 2017, and March 31, 2019, by any other U.S. Customs and Border Protection office, including the Office of the Commissioner and the Office of Acquisition, that include the word or phrase "SOFNEX" or "SOF NEX."
- Any registration, travel, or attendance records from July 1, 2017, through March 31, 2019, for CBP personnel attending or presenting at an event called "SOFNEX."

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Matthew Petti

Sincerely,

Robbin Haynes
